Sarathchandra have been caused injustice by placing them in salary Step – Grade viii saying that the salary paid placing them in salary Step – Grade ix is incorrect in the preparation of salaries in accordance with Finance Division Circular No. 02 of 2008, and by deducting the sum of Rs. 229,084.60 paid in excess, in installments of Rs. 5000/- and if such injustice had been caused to them, to what relief they are entitled.
